name: Spirit Pill
detailedDescription: A fundamental pill for any cultivator. It contains a small amount of spiritual essence to jumpstart Qi circulation.

name: Healing Pill
detailedDescription: Crafted from medicinal herbs, this pill accelerates the body's natural healing process. Essential for survival in harsh realms.

name: Grand Spirit Pill
description: Refined pill. Permanently increases Max Qi and restores vast amounts.

name: Vitality Pill
description: Rare medicine. Permanently increases Max HP.

name: Rusty Hammer
detailedDescription: An old, heavy hammer once used by a master blacksmith. It remains remarkably sturdy and is essential for basic crafting.

name: Iron Ore
detailedDescription: A chunk of dense iron ore. While common, its high spiritual conductivity makes it a staple in low-level artifact forging.

name: Flying Sword
detailedDescription: A standard-issue sword for disciples. It can be psychically controlled to strike enemies from a distance, provided the wielder has sufficient Qi.

name: Divine Eyes
description: A beam of concentrated spiritual energy.

name: Triple Fireball Staff
description: Fires three fireballs in a fan pattern.

name: Spirit Burst Sword
description: Unleashes a rapid sequence of flying swords.

name: Spiritual Aura
description: Creates a protective zone of spiritual energy.

name: Improved Qi Sword
description: A sword infused with concentrated Qi.

name: Flame Sword
description: A blade that burns with spiritual fire.

name: Fire Essence
description: Concentrated heat from a spirit vein.

name: Heavenly Flame Sword
description: A mythical blade forged in celestial fire.
